content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DTU Student/ Project Intern Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Delhi Technological University (DTU) is conducting this recruitment for Student/Project Intern positions under a MeitY sponsored project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Student/Project Intern post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DTU Student/Project Intern recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 08-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly via Email. Candidates need to send their documents to the designated email addresses.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary provided for the Student/Project Intern post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of ₹15,000/- per month, inclusive of all components.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed or be pursuing M.E./M.Tech, B.E./B.Tech in relevant engineering disciplines, or MCA with the requisite minimum percentage marks.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 25 years, with age relaxations applicable as per government, DTU, or funding agency norms.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application email be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be emailed to [email protected] with a CC to [email protected] and [email protected] as specified.

faq.question: Q9. What subject line should be used in the email application?
faq.answer: The subject line of the email must be 'Application for the post of Student/Project Intern under MeitY sponsored project'.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for DTU Student/Project Intern?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications based on eligibility and experience, followed by an interview by the Selection Committee.
